summary: SIMD weighted linear combination. Computes *a1 = a3[3] + (element 0 of a2[0]) * a3[0] + (element 0 of a2[1]) * a3[1], where the scale factors are the lowest 32-bit elements of the two source vectors a2[0] and a2[1], splatted across the lanes via shuffle. Straight-line __m128 store; no branching beyond the three input vectors.

operations.description: Splat the first element of a2[0] across all four lanes and multiply lane-wise with a3[0].
Splat the first element of a2[1] across all four lanes and multiply lane-wise with a3[1].
Sum the two scaled products with a3[3] (the additive or translation term).
Store the resulting 128-bit vector into the output pointer a1 (this field 0).

unresolved: Semantic purpose unknown: the expression is a two-term weighted combination with an additive term, but the packet does not identify whether a2 and a3 are matrices, quaternions, or blend weights.

The packet prelabel assigns this function as a structural twin of FloatClamp (004646c0), but the SIMD multiply-accumulate shape does not match clamping semantics; the cluster-copy label is treated as DERIVED and not relied on.
a2 elements are typed unsigned int in the prototype but are reinterpreted as packed floats by the SIMD operations.
